✅ Last answer: A, 550 mmHg.
Total = 200 + 2x. At 30 min, 500 → x = 150, so A fell to 50 = 200/4: two half-lives, t½ = 15 min. 45 min = 3 half-lives → A = 25, x = 175 → total = 550 mmHg.

✅ Last answer: C, 12 chromosomes, 6 pg.
After meiosis I each cell has 6 chromosomes (2 chromatids each), 6 pg. In anaphase II the sister chromatids split, so 12 chromosomes are counted (by centromeres), but DNA stays 6 pg until cytokinesis.

✅ Last answer: 34.
Let n = ⌊x⌋, so x = √(5n − 4) with n ≤ x < n + 1 → 1 ≤ n ≤ 4. Roots: 1, √6, √11, 4. Sum of squares = 1 + 6 + 11 + 16 = 34. (Treating ⌊x⌋ as x misses √6 and √11!)
